purpose: UX-04/UX-05: preserve unsaved recovery and reset form entries when public navigation is cancelled, without storing credentials.
ownerSpecification: Прозрачная Цена — инженерное ТЗ быстрого UX-ремонта v2.0, 23.09.2026, UX-04/UX-05.
coordination: Current main 2365c9b38cbb366cda628904d4f11da4cb4afff9. Root cause in PublicHeaderInteractions: early return when recovery PublicSiteHeader has no mobile menu, so dirty-state listeners never mount. Separate effect is limited to /platform-v7/forgot-password. Potential same-file and acceptance-config integration with #5541/#5542 must be forward-synced after their merge.
requiredInvariants: No form value, token or password is persisted to storage, logs or URL by the guard.
Cancelled same-tab navigation from a dirty recovery form retains both entered passwords or the email address.
Confirmed navigation is allowed without duplicate custom prompts; direct reload/Back uses the browser's native beforeunload guard.
No change to reset/recovery API, token authority, password policy, submission semantics or auth roles.
Existing acceptance selections and thresholds remain; additive RU/EN/ZH and 320/390/1280 browser checks.
Contact and registration form navigation policy is unaffected.
